commit 5dfdd2495e14590dab7412132b4f341f8df2c8fe
Author: Your Name <you@example.com>
Date:   Thu Oct 1 23:29:09 2026 +0100

    Ignore vanished files when hardening a shared Windows evidence cache
    
    Concurrent stores race on each other's transient SQLite journal files.
    hardenWindowsAcl rethrew when a file it had enumerated was deleted and
    re-created before the attribute read, failing one of two simultaneous
    processes with 'Could not find file'. Missing files are now skipped;
    any other error on an existing file still fails closed.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit 8dd914a8d693ff872e676ffd10f73878d17ec77e
Author: Your Name <you@example.com>
Date:   Thu Oct 1 23:00:03 2026 +0100

    Tolerate Node 22.12 Windows stat dev=0 when verifying a workspace read
    
    On Node 22.12.0 for Windows, fs.promises.stat(path).dev is 0 while a file
    handle's stat reports the volume serial, so every workspace file read was
    rejected as 'Workspace path changed during access'. Compare dev only when
    both values are real; inode and realpath checks are unchanged.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

 src/workspace.ts | 4 +++-
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

commit 8b547d1693abfa2aad8269459e67bf08ff9f51e5
Author: Your Name <you@example.com>
Date:   Thu Oct 1 22:24:34 2026 +0100

    Accept Administrators-group ownership of private config for administrator callers
    
    Elevated Windows processes create files and directories owned by the
    Administrators group (S-1-5-32-544), not their own SID, so setup and
    doctor rejected their own private files with 'Wrong owner' (seen on the
    GitHub windows runner). The group is already an accepted ACL principal;
    it is now also accepted as owner when the caller is an administrator.
    Standard users still require ownership by their own SID.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

 src/private-config.ts | 6 +++++-
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
